author: ABMN Staff
title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 3rd (AAPL, AC, AT1, B4B3, BTA, CCAP, CMG, CORE, CVS, DHER)
text:
Investment Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Thursday, January 3rd:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $175.00 price target by analysts at Nomura. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) was given a $160.00 price target by analysts at Sanford C. Bernstein. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co..
Associated Capital Group (NYSE:AC) had its average rating reaffirmed by analysts at Scotiabank. They currently have a $38.00 target price on the stock.
Aroundtown (ETR:AT1) was given a €7.55 ($8.78) target price by analysts at Nord/LB. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Metro (ETR:B4B3) was given a €12.40 ($14.42) target price by analysts at Sanford C. Bernstein. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
BT Group (LON:BTA) had its hold rating reiterated by analysts at Deutsche Bank AG. Deutsche Bank AG currently has a GBX 235 ($3.07) price target on the stock.
Corestate Capital (ETR:CCAP) was given a €58.00 ($67.44) target price by analysts at Berenberg Bank. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Chipotle Mexican Grill (NYSE:CMG) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. The firm currently has a $525.00 price target on the stock.
Core-Mark (NASDAQ:CORE) was upgraded by analysts at Sidoti from a neutral rating to a buy rating.
CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Bank of America Corp. They currently have a $92.00 price target on the stock.
CVS Health (NYSE:CVS) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald. The firm currently has a $96.00 target price on the stock. The analysts wrote, “We rate shares of CVS Health Corp. (CVS) Overweight. The company has one the largest PBMs in the U.S. and a nationally recognized retail brand. We believe the acquisition of AET adds value, as the addition of AET’s clinical expertise and capabilities should allow the combined company to transform MinuteClinic into a “healthcare hub” and reduce cost of care by shifting patients to lower cost CVS-owned settings. We believe the risk/reward tradeoff is compelling at current levels. Valuation Summary Our price target is $96, which is DCF-based.””
Delivery Hero (ETR:DHER) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at Deutsche Bank AG.
Frontier Developments (LON:FDEV) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Berenberg Bank. They currently have a GBX 1,600 ($20.91) price target on the stock.
Firestone Diamonds (LON:FDI) had its speculative buy rating reissued by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. The firm currently has a GBX 20 ($0.26) target price on the stock.
General Electric (NYSE:GE) was given a $10.00 target price by analysts at Credit Suisse Group AG. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Gem Diamonds (LON:GEMD) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. They currently have a GBX 145 ($1.89) price target on the stock.
Hillenbrand (NYSE:HI) was upgraded by analysts at Sidoti from a neutral rating to a buy rating.
Kenmare Resources (LON:KMR) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. The firm currently has a GBX 475 ($6.21) target price on the stock.
Nordex (ETR:NDX1) was given a €11.00 ($12.79) price target by analysts at Goldman Sachs Group Inc. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Petra Diamonds (LON:PDL) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. The firm currently has a GBX 70 ($0.91) target price on the stock.
Restaurant Brands International (NYSE:QSR) (TSE:QSR) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Robert W. Baird. Robert W. Baird currently has a $66.00 target price on the stock.
Saia (NASDAQ:SAIA) had its positive rating reaffirmed by analysts at KeyCorp. The firm currently has a $75.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $80.00.
SB One Bancorp (NASDAQ:SBBX) was upgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a sell rating to a hold rating. According to Zacks, “SB One Bancorp is the holding company for SB One Bank a commercial bank. It offers financial products and services which includes checking and savings accounts, commercial and consumer loans, investment, insurance, fund transfer, cash management and online banking services. The company offers SB One Insurance Agency Inc. and wealth management services through Sussex Investment Services. SB One Bancorp, formerly known as Sussex Bancorp, is based in Rockaway, United States. “
Companhia de Saneamento Basico (NYSE:SBS) was downgraded by analysts at Janney Montgomery Scott from a buy rating to a neutral rating.
Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) was upgraded by analysts at Zacks Investment Research from a hold rating to a buy rating. Zacks Investment Research currently has $47.00 target price on the stock. According to Zacks, “Schwab’s shares have outperformed the industry past six months. The company has a positive record of earnings surprises in the recent quarters, having surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the trailing four quarters. Earnings estimates have remained stable ahead of the company's fourth quarter 2018 results. The company remains well positioned to gain from the rising rate environment and its initiatives to strengthen trading income. While continuous rise in expenses and significant dependence on fee-based revenue streams remain major near-term concerns, the company’s enhanced capital deployment plans indicate a strong balance sheet position.”
Salzgitter (ETR:SZG) was given a €28.00 ($32.56) price target by analysts at Independent Research GmbH. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Takeaway.com (AMS:TKWY) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at Deutsche Bank AG.
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) was given a $220.00 price target by analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.. The firm currently has a sell rating on the stock.
